title: Mark photos while culling and denoise them in a resumable background or CLI queue
highlight: Mark photos with Q, then denoise the marked folder overnight from the app or CLI. Completed results are verified and skipped.
notes: Dedicated persistent mark, thumbnail badge and library filters. One shared sequential worker with cancellation, source/settings/model/runtime identities, content hashes, no-clobber outputs and crash recovery. Best/Fast produce sensor DNG; other methods retain TIFF/PNG. Sharpen is optional. Fast/Best preserve editable RAW adjustments; rendered methods refuse edited RAWs and continue with the rest, while unedited RAW-to-TIFF uses neutral non-RAW metadata. Edit baking is deferred to #324. Existing one-shot processing and default renders are unchanged.
